text: The Echo of Aln'sharan is a cloud serpent mount obtained through the following steps: #Complete the "Legend of Aln'sharan" questline at Har'kuai in Harandar. #Collect 500 Mysterious Skyshards, which drop from mobs in Harandar after the questline. #Return to Kuri in Har'kuai and use the extra action button that pops up: #With the buff, find Aln'sharan flying somewhere above Harandar and interact with him. You will need to dismount in the air, since Aln'sharan cannot be interacted with while mounted, so consider having a way to break the fall. Obtaining this mount will grant the Herald of the Goddess achievement.
Ebonwing Kaliri are kaliri found at Shaz'gul in Shadowmoon Valley.
Ebon Plague is a ability card from the War of the Ancients set.
The Egg of Unknown Contents is obtained by hatching a Magically Altered Egg with some Everburning Ruby Coals. Combining it with a Speck of Bronze Dust will age it into a Sleeping Ancient Mammoth.
Eight of Serpents is one of the cards that can be obtained from Darkmoon Card of Mists. It is one of the cards needed to create Serpent Deck.
Eight Views on Defense against Hostile Runes is sold by the following vendors in the City of Threads for : *Gee G. G'mazund *Krivit *Nuel Prill *Th'z of the Dark Web *Venomscribe Xesh XI *Violesca
Edict of Rage is a power obtained from Kuldas' Toolbox during Awakening The Machine.
Edict of Stamina is a power obtained from Kuldas' Toolbox during Awakening The Machine.
Edict of Haste is a power obtained from Kuldas' Toolbox during Awakening The Machine.
Edict of Alacrity is a power obtained from Kuldas' Toolbox during Awakening The Machine.
Eggsistential Crisis is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating Belo'ren after infusing the Sunwell Egg with Light and Void magic in the March on Quel'Danas on Normal difficulty or higher.
Eight of Blood can be looted from various creatures in . Combining the entire set creates Darkmoon Deck: Blood.
Eight of Rot can be looted from various creatures in . Combining the entire set creates Darkmoon Deck: Rot.
Eight of Hunt can be looted from various creatures in . Combining the entire set creates Darkmoon Deck: Hunt.
Eight of Void can be looted from various creatures in . Combining the entire set creates Darkmoon Deck: Void.
Electromantic Devastator's Mail is a mail set purchased from Ziri "The Wrench" Littlesprocket in Gnomeregan.
Elder Spineshells are dragon turtles located in Island Expeditions.
Electromantic Resonance Transducer is a Teleportation Pad located in Cold Hearth Manor in and Saldean's Farm in , part of Rift Away.
Elder's Hemolymphal Periapt drops from The Coaglamation in the City of Threads.
Electricity Generators are located in the Sidestreet Sluice.

Elemental Focusing Lens is an optional crafting reagent made with Khaz Algar Jewelcrafting that can provide a small DPS boost. The ability to make this item is learned by having 15 profession knowledge points in Glasswork under Shaping. The item this optional reagent is applied to does not have to be socketed because the effect will select any socketed gems on any currently-equipped gear.
Elemental Summoners are found in the Athenaeum in Suramar. They summon Moonfall Manafiends during Starweaver's Fate.
Elemental Echo is an ability card from the War of the Ancients set.
Elemental Purge is an ability card from the War of the Ancients set.
Elemental Flames is an ability card from the War of the Elements set.
Elemental Vision is an ability card from the Worldbreaker set.
Elite: The War Within Season 1 is a feat of strength earned by reaching the rank of Elite during The War Within Season 1.
Elite: The War Within Season 2 is a feat of strength earned by reaching the rank of Elite during The War Within Season 2.
Elite: The War Within Season 3 is a feat of strength earned by reaching the rank of Elite during The War Within Season 3.
Elite: Midnight Season 1 is a feat of strength earned by reaching the rank of Elite during Midnight Season 1.
Elite: Midnight Season 2 is a feat of strength earned by gaining the rank of Elite during Midnight Season 2.
Elmira Moonsurge is an ally card from the War of the Elements set.
The Elwynn kobolds are a clan of kobolds originally from the Redridge Mountains that can be found in the Elwynn Forest and Westfall.
Elune's Fires is a Druid rune for bracers. It is learned from Rune of the Moon Goddess.
Elusive Moonfang Dreamsabers are dreamsabers summoned by Elusive Creature Bait throughout the Emerald Dream.
Ember Worg Hides are a stack of Ember Worg Hides spawn at Flamestar Post in the Burning Steppes after turning in the quest A Future Project (Alliance).
Elwynn Fence is housing decor purchased from Captain Lancy Revshon in Stormwind City for .
Elwynn Fencepost is housing decor purchased from Captain Lancy Revshon in Stormwind City for .
Emerald Blossom Dreamstone is a achievement reward from Dragonflight Season 3 Hero.
Emerald Mark of Mastery is an achievement reward from Dragonflight Season 3 Master.
The Emerald Enclave is a located in Valdrakken. The area is mostly inhabited by members of the green dragonflight and features their motifs.

Emblem of the Violet Eye can be purchased from Pix Xizzix in Booty Bay for after obtaining any of the runes listed below. It can be sent to other characters on the account and used to purchase any other rune from the list from the Rune Broker in any capital city.

Emblem of Dishonor can be purchased from Pix Xizzix in Booty Bay for after obtaining any of the runes listed below. It can be sent to other characters on the account and used to purchase any other rune from the list from the Rune Broker in any capital city.

Emblem of the Wild Gods can be purchased from Pix Xizzix in Booty Bay for after obtaining any of the runes listed below. It can be sent to other characters on the account and used to purchase any other rune from the list from the Rune Broker in any capital city.

Emblem of the Worldcore can be purchased from Pix Xizzix in Booty Bay for after obtaining any of the runes listed below. It can be sent to other characters on the account and used to purchase any other rune from the list from the Rune Broker in any capital city.
Emerald Tender is a green dragonspawn tending to the green dragonflight eggs at the Ruby Lifeshrine in the Waking Shores.
Empowered Restorative Symbiote is an objective of To the Test: Symbiotic Glowspore Grip.
Empowered Unstable Affliction is an Affliction warlock talent.
Empowered Meeting Stones are found during delves. They serve as respawn points.
Empowered Boneguards are skeletal trolls located in the Darkspear Training Grounds on the Echo Isles during the Heritage of the Darkspear.
Empowered Tinderbox is a quest reward from New and Improved.
Empowered Flames are bound fire elementals located in the Forbidden Reach.

The Emperor Thaurissan is a leader unit of the Blackrock family. Known for his ability to enhance his allies' attacks with fire, Thaurissan adds a burning effect to all non-elemental damage dealt by his allies.
Empowered Mulch is created by Herbalists with Khaz Algar Herbalism.
Empowered Eyes of Gul'dan are eyes of Kilrogg summoned by Gul'dan at the Font of Night in the Nighthold raid.
Empowered Attendants are attendants found in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Empowered Coldheart Ascendants are kyrian found in the Coldheart Interstitia wing in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Empowered Coldheart Javelineers are kyrian found in the Coldheart Interstitia wing in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Empowered Deadsoul Echoes are shades found in the Mort'regar wing in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Empowered Deadsoul Shades are shades found in the Mort'regar wing in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Empowered Deadsoul Shamblers are shades found in the Mort'regar wing in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Empowered Flameforge Enforcers are Maw guards found in the Soulforges wing in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Empowered Guardians are automa found in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Empowered Mawsworn Cremators are Maw casters found in the Adamant Vaults in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Empowered Mawsworn Soulwardens are Maw casters found in the Adamant Vaults in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Empowered Mawsworn Woebringers are Maw casters found in the Adamant Vaults in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Emergency Soul Link is made with Midnight Engineering, discovered through the Recycling ability. The lower tier version has a cast time of 6 seconds, while the higher tier version has a cast time of 3 seconds.

The Empowered Snail is a magma slug found inside the lava at the Scalecracker Peaks on the Waking Shores. In order to obtain theMagmashell mount, an Empty Magma Shell has to used on this snail, which will start a 20-second channel. Once the cast is finished, Magmashell will be added to the mount inventory.
The Empowered Water Fury is a water fury found at the Genesis Falls on the Waking Shores.
Emptied Venom Canister is located at the Umbral Bazaar in the City of Threads in Azj-Kahet.
Empowering Crystal of Anub'ikkaj drops from Anub'ikkaj in the Dawnbreaker instance.

Enchant Chest - Waking Stats is created with Dragon Isles Enchanting (40); automatically learned upon unlocking the Magical Reinforcement subspecialization. Amount of primary stat increased depends on the quality of the enchant.

Enchant Chest - Reserve of Intellect is created with Dragon Isles Enchanting (20); automatically learned upon putting 20 knowledge points into the Magical Reinforcement subspecialization. Amount of Intellect and Mana increased depends on the quality of the enchant.
Empurror is a purrkin located on a ledge north of the Oasis in K'aresh looking at the Vanquisher's Wake island. Players are tasked with /petting it for Dangerous Prowlers of K'aresh.

Empty Mysterious Potion is obtained automatically by drinking the following potions during the Winds of Mysterious Fortune buff event. It can be sold as junk to a vendor. *Potion of Mysterious Celerity *Potion of Mysterious Systemshock *Potion of Mysterious Tenacity *Potion of Mysterious Swiftstrike *Potion of Mysterious Conflagration *Potion of Mysterious Tremorshards *Potion of Mysterious Revivification *Potion of Mysterious Frostbound

Empty Manacells are looted from Manaforge Netherdrifters, Manaforge Siphoners, Manaforge Warders, and Recommissioned Mechs in the Ethereum Refinery in the Voidstorm. Lothraxion asked the adventurer to obtain these to disrupt the ethereal forces empowering the Voidstorm's assault on the Sunwell.
The Enamored Soulwing is a glimmerfly found just north of the Seat of Eternal Hymns in Bastion.
The Enamored Spiritwing is a glimmerfly found just north of the Seat of Eternal Hymns in Bastion.

Enchant Helm - Empowered Blessing of Speed is created with Midnight Enchanting. The recipe is automatically learned upon unlocking the Worldsoul Wards subspecialization (Elevating Equipment ⮞ Haranir Heightening ⮞ Worldsoul Wards).
Empyrean Zapper is a PvP power that can be obtained from a Ethereal Tool Rack in the Slayer's Rise. It provides "low gravity" during the Ethereal Disruption PvP event.

Empty Mana Jewels were created with Conjure Mana Jewel, an ability that existed in early development. The spell was eventually repurposed into Conjure Mana Jade, and this item was left without a purpose.
Enchanting Dreambow is an appearance unlocked through the use of Moonberry's Many Mischief Makers.
Enchanting Dreamblade is an appearance unlocked through the use of Moonberry's Many Mischief Makers.
Enchanting Dreamstaff is an appearance unlocked through the use of Moonberry's Many Mischief Makers.
Enchanted Sigil: Living Dreams is crafted by Enchanting(250); learned from speaking with the Shadowy Figure in Moonglade after completing Waking the Nightmare.
Enchanted Sigil: Flowing Waters is sold by Duke Hydraxis in for upon reaching with the Hydraxian Waterlords. It teleports the user to Duke Hydraxis.
The Enchanted Spellweave Carpet is a flying carpet mount that can be purchased for from Auzin in Dalaran above Northrend during Wrath of the Lich King timewalking events.
Enchanted Flare is a hunter ability learned from Tome of Enchanted Flare. It can be used to create light in the Karazhan Crypts dungeon.
Enchanted Ledgers are flying tomes located in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.
Enchanted Mooncloth Bag is a 16-slot bag. Four is provided from the Time Starter Pack, available on the Chinese Battle.net Shop for the Titan Reforged - Chrono realms.

Endless Possibility is the buff that is applied from the Vial of Endless Draconic Scales. It randomizes the player's available customization options of a dragonriding mount on summon. Prior to the hotfix on 22 January 2024, the spell was learned from the Manuscript of Endless Possibility, available for use from the dragonriding list of abilities of the spellbook and it acted as a toggle for it without a duration limit.

Endiri Dawnsurge is an Arathi located in Mereldar in Hallowfall. He noticed listlessness and snippiness in the eyes of Shinda Creedpike, one of his lieutenants. During the events of the war in Khaz Algar, the day before adventurers entered the city, Endiri gave his soldiers a day for relaxation, and Shinda failed to report for duty the next day, so Endiri sent an adventurer to find him. After they assisted Shinda, he was ready to report back to Endiri and accept any punishment, but he did not give Shinda any. Later, during Children's Week, he met with Skibbles, spoke with her about being a knight and showed her a few moves. Endiri was among the forces of the Vanguard of the Light fighting ag
Energized Scrap Pups are mechanical wolves summoned by Jawbreaker from the corpses of Rusty Scrap Pups at the Heaps on Mechagon Island.
Energized Folios are flying tomes located in the Lycaneum on the Isle of Quel'Danas.
Energy Splinter is a PvP power that can be obtained from a Ethereal Tool Rack in the Slayer's Rise. It provides "low gravity" during the Ethereal Disruption PvP event.
Enhanced Restoration is a druid ability learned from Leaflet of Enhanced Restoration.
Enhanced Blessings is a paladin ability learned from Testament of Enhanced Blessings.
Enormous Glob of Fire Honey drops from Coalesced Living Honey on the Isle of Dorn. Harvester Farnee requested it to patch up a Slumbering Mountain Giant.
Engorged Crawlers are undercrawlers located in Ara-Kara, City of Echoes.
Engourged Ambershards are earth furies found at the Crystal Fissure in Highmountain while a player rides Rageshard during Fury Road.
Ensemble: Auchenai Priest's Raiment is sold by Cupri in Shattrath City for .
Ensemble: Cenarion Mender's Battlegear is sold by Cupri in Shattrath City for .
Ensemble: Boulderfist Mystic's Battlegear is sold by Cupri in Shattrath City for .

Ensemble: Aegis of Hidden Stars can be purchased for 4,000 Resonance Crystals from Reno Jackson. From The War Within Season 2 to Season 3, this item can be purchased for 5,000 Undercoin from Sir Finley Mrrgglton.
Enraging Bite was a hunter pet ability taught by bear trainers during the beta.
Ensemble: Cloaks of the Green Mountains is sold by Freddie Threads for 4,000 Bronze at the Infinite Bazaar south of Dalaran during Legion Remix.
Ensemble: Cloak of Infinite Potential is given for free by Nostwin on the Timeless Isle to players with Infinite Power XII. It provides all appearances for the Cloak of Infinite Potential.

Ensemble: Moonlit Burden of Unrelenting Justice is awarded from Trading Post Enthusiast, an achievement granted to players who complete their Traveler's Log for the Trading Post 12 times. Note that those completions do not need to be consecutive. The appearances are also used during nighttime by the Ensemble: Burden of Unrelenting Justice.
Ensemble: Forest Dweller's Butterfly Attire is the Traveler's Log completion reward for April 2026.
Ensemble: Ornaments of the Spring Butterfly is available for 100x Love Token from Kiera Torres in Elwynn Forest and Lythianne Morningspear in Durotar during Love is in the Air.
Ensemble: Memories of a Dying Star is sold by Ba'choso at Shadow Point in K'aresh for a Loombeast Silk.
Ensemble: Highmountain Riverscales is sold by Larah Treebender for 15,000 Bronze at the Infinite Bazaar south of Dalaran during Legion Remix.
Ensemble: Highmountain Hides is sold by Larah Treebender for 15,000 Bronze at the Infinite Bazaar south of Dalaran during Legion Remix.
Ensemble: Moonfall Robes is sold by Larah Treebender for 15,000 Bronze at the Infinite Bazaar south of Dalaran during Legion Remix.
Ensemble: Moonlit Assassin's Attire is available for purchase at the Trading Post for 700 Trader's Tender.
Ensemble: Vestments of the Shattered Vale is sold for 5,000 Bronze (Pandaria Remix) by at the Infinite Bazaar locations during Pandaria Remix.
Ensemble: Telhamat Anchorite's Raiment is sold by Cupri in Shattrath City for . It grants the appearances for the Purple version of the Telhamant Anchorite's Raiment.
Ensemble: Twilight Zealot's Battleplate is sold by Kiatke in Stormwind City and Orgrimmar for .
Ensemble: Truly Heartfelt Shoulders is available for 40x Love Token from Kiera Torres outside Stormwind City and Lythianne Morningspear outside Orgrimmar during Love is in the Air.
Ensemble: Shadowmoon Anchorite's Guardplate is sold by Tempra in Stormshield and Kronnus in Warspear for .
Enslaved Frost Elementals are ice elementals located in Island Expeditions.
Ensemble: Villager's City Collection is available for purchase at the Trading Post for 440 Trader's Tender.
Ensemble: Villager's City Attire is available for purchase at the Trading Post for 440 Trader's Tender.
Ensemble: Twilight Acolyte's Regalia is sold by Kiatke in Stormwind City or Orgrimmar for .
Ensemble: Twilight Hunter's Guise is sold by Kiatke in Stormwind City or Orgrimmar for .
Ensemble: Vestments of the Twisted Grove is sold by Kiatke in Stormwind City or Orgrimmar for .
Entropic Fel Stone can be created from a Condensed Fire Magic and looted from a Primordial Fire Cache.
Entwined Chimeric Legguards drop from Izo, the Grand Splicer in the City of Threads.

Two portals named Enter the Shadowlands appear in the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds after defeating Ner'zhul. They allow transport back to the Edge of Reality. One is located at the start of the Crypt of the Ancients, just inside the dungeon entrance, while the other is located at the top of the Altar of Shadow near the spot where players first encounter Ner'zhul.

__NOTOC__ Entropy Enhancer is a crafting reagent part that is made with and used in Khaz Algar Engineering. It is a discovery learned through the ability Scour Through Scrap, which requires the Inventing and the Scrapper specializations.
Enterprising Hero: The War Within Season Two is a feat of strength earned by ending The War Within Mythic+ Season 2 with a Mythic+ Rating in the top 0.1% of all players in your region.
Enter the Fray is a Legion: Remix ability granted by the Empyreal Orders artifact trait. It activates upon casting Vindicator's Judgment, and transforms into Lightbound Passage.
Ensouled Frosts are ice elementals found at the Snowblind Cliffs in Highmountain when DANGER: Mawat'aki is up.

Equinox Reach is the southern island of Telogrus Rift. It can be reached from with a two-way Void Rift from Cosmic Horizon.

Eoghan Knatley is an Arathi stationed at Beledar's Bounty in Hallowfall. When Hallowfall once again came under threat by the Sureki and the army was stretched thin, a call to arms was issued to those with the strength to wield a weapon. Eoghan answered the call, joining the Flame's Radiance.
Epic Edition: Voidlight Surger is a feat of strength that is earned for obtaining the mount, Voidlight Surger.

Ephemeral Star Ooze is fished up from Abyssal Swirls in the waters of the Coiled Isle. It spawns the Three-Eyed Fish.
Epaulets of Overwhelming Force is dropped by Hungering Destroyer in Castle Nathria.
Escaped Podling is a podling located in the Barrows of Reverie in the Emerald Dream. It is seen briefly during the Fruitface event, once the first Missing Fruit has been looted.

__NOTOC__ Errick Ryston is an Arathi located in the Lightspark Commissary in Hallowfall. There, he works as a caretaker, making sure the students are fed. When Hallowfall once again came under threat by the Sureki and the army was stretched thin, a call to arms was issued to those with the strength to wield a weapon. Errick answered the call, joining the Flame's Radiance. He was stationed at Faerin's Advance in Azj-Kahet.
Escape Line is located in the Laboratory of the Grand Splicer of the City of Threads in Azj-Kahet.
The Escaped Rat is a rat located at the Forgegrounds in Dornogal. It is found behind the teleporter leading to the Undermine, from which it likely escaped.
Essence of Yu'lon is an achievement-rewarded toy for earning Infinite Power XII by acquiring 4200 Threads for the Cloak of Infinite Potential during Pandaria Remix.
Essence of Life is a power obtained by interacting with a Lifeblood Crystal left behind by a Treasure Wraith during delves.
Essence of Aggression is an ability card from the Crown of the Heavens set.
Essence of Defense is an ability card from the Crown of the Heavens set.
Essence of Focus is an ability card from the Crown of the Heavens set.
Essence of War is an ability card from the Crown of the Heavens set.

The Eternal Kurgans is a large Maruuk Centaur burial site now in the hands of Clan Ukhel, who are loyal to Clan Nokhud. In stark contrast to the other centaur clans, the Ukhel practice necromancy, using the magic to raise the spirits of centaur, bakar, and ohuna that had been laid to rest here.
Eternal Flutterers are glimmerflies flying around the Walk of Recollection in Bastion.

Eternal Gladiator is a PvP title rewarded from the Eternal Gladiator: Shadowlands Season 4 feat of strength, earned by ending the season in the top 0.1% of the 3v3 arena ladder (requires at least 150 games won). It precedes the name in the following format: :Eternal Gladiator
Ethereal Sash Cache is rewarded from completing the achievement Moonlighter by completing two Warrants.

Eternus's Trial: Timeways Manifested is an affix for WoW Remix: Legion Mythic+. It is one of the four unique affixes applied to keystones at level 2 or higher. In keys with this affix, Eternus will occasionally appear and cast the following ability: * A summoned Manifested Timeways splits in two on death, then both of those will split again on death, for a potential total of seven Manifested Timeways per summon. Each slain Manifested Timeways grants a stack of , increasing secondary stats by 2%. If a Manifested Timeways finishes casting , it will disappear without splitting or granting Stabilized Time.
Eternal Slaves were drogbar planned to appear in Highmountain. They may have been located in the Slave Enclave.
Evercore is an engineering part obtained by using the Recycling ability on most crafted crafting reagents. It is used to craft items with Midnight Engineering.
Evergrove Keepers are keepers of the grove found at the Verdant Wilds during Island Expeditions.
Ever Painting is an exploration achievement earned by finding all painter's easels in Eversong Woods. It rewards the Silvermoon Painter's Cushion decor.
Evermore is a wolf located in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar.
The Excavation Site is an unexplored city near Durotar that was excavated by Gazlowe's engineers.

Excessively Bejeweled Curio drops from Chrome King Gallywix in the Liberation of Undermine. It can be turned in to Kari Bridgeblaster in the Incontinental Hotel in the Undermine for a piece of Liberation of Undermine tier set gear.

Excavator's Haversack is created with Khaz Algar Tailoring. The crafting recipe is taught by Pattern: Excavator's Haversack. When equipped, the cooldown of Overload Empowered Deposit is reduced by an additional 1% when mining.
Excessive Force is an ability card from the Worldbreaker set.
Expedited Takeoff is a dracthyr racial ability. It is granted after completing both the dracthyr starting experience and learning dragonriding.
Exorcist is a paladin ability. It is learned from Testament of the Exorcist.
Expanded Intellect is a mage ability learned from Tome of Expanded Intellect.

Executor Nizrek, codenamed the Vizier, is one of the three leaders of the Severed Threads conspiracy, the other two being Widow Arak'nai (the Weaver) and Anub'azal (the General). He leads a titular subfaction, the Vizier, and is found in the City of Threads.

Exile's Hideaway is a cave located in the Preserve in Zuldazar. It is to the east of Nesingwary's Trek far back from the road at the base of the mountains. The Exile's Lament is found in the back of the cave.

Exhausted Hornswogs are hornswogs found at the Hornswog Hollow on the Waking Shores during Grand Hunts. Players have to pick them up and then aim their Roll Hornswog ability at Swarmed Hunters to free them from the Rowdy Hornswogs that are swarming them.
Executioner's Mark is a Warrior ability card from the Twilight of the Dragons set.

Exploring Azeroth: Islands and Isles is a Warcraft book by Alex Acks presenting information on the Broken Isles, Zandalar, Kul Tiras, and the Dragon Isles. It is the fifth book of the Exploring Azeroth series, released on November 19, 2024, in the US and previously, on November 6, in the UK.
Explorer's Soul is randomly obtained when killing any enemy with Drain Soul. It teaches the Explorer Imp ability. The item fits in soul bags.
Explorers' League Supplies are found in the Delver's Headquarters in Dornogal. They are also found near the start of delves and next to the Empowered Restoration Stone.

Explore Azj-Kahet is an exploration achievement earned by exploring Azj-Kahet and the City of Threads. This is one of the criteria of Khaz Algar Explorer, itself a criterion of The War Within Pathfinder, then of Worldsoul-Searching.
Experiment Notes is located in the Laboratory of the Grand Splicer of the City of Threads in Azj-Kahet.
Explorer's League Deepholm Expedition Tabard is sold by Kiatke in Stormwind City and Orgrimmar for .
Experimental Goresilk Chestguard drops from Ki'katal the Harvester in Ara-Kara, City of Echoes.
Experiment 08752's Band drops from Izo, the Grand Splicer in the City of Threads.
Explosive Caltrops is a Utility ability in Plunderstorm. The caltrops last for six seconds.
